The '''base nose flute''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument.<ref name="Payback" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="ESB">The scene in which base note flutes are mentioned in "[[Payback: The Tale of Dengar]]" occurs while [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his companions are present at [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], as depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]; ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the film, and thus the scene in "Payback", in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> some were incorporated into a [[Turan]] [[Unidentified Turan band|band]] that performed in a [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Cloud City/Legends|colony]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="Payback" />

==Behind the scenes==
Base nose flute were briefly mentioned in "[[Payback: The Tale of Dengar]]," a short story written by [[Dave Wolverton]] that was included in a [[1996]] collection called ''[[Tales of the Bounty Hunters]]''.<ref name="Payback" />
